principle: Function is the capacity to produce; product is the concrete produced outcome. Lines and machines connect them without merging them.

layers.definition: Direction, priority, budget, arbitration, and safety policy.
Stable organizational capabilities that can act on many products.
must_not_contain: single-release artifact inventory as service definition

layers.definition: Reusable flow that turns inputs into a class of outcomes.
must_not_contain: single product as the line definition

layers.definition: Reusable line for defect containment, root-cause analysis, class repair, regression gates, and postmortem.
must_not_contain: normal editorial work disguised as incident work

layers.definition: Standards and protocols used by functions and lines.
must_not_contain: specific release payload as a standard

layers.definition: Executable stations, scripts, release-machine modules, local tools, and LLM bridges.
Concrete outcomes: a release, article package, dataset, product build, or public record.
must_not_contain: definition of the organization function itself
